layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no clear swing trade setup stands out right now.

Bitcoin is hovering around $64,370 with high dominance at 56.5%, which means altcoins are generally getting squeezed. All the swing trade candidates show bearish chart structures — prices below their moving averages, downtrends, and no strong reversal signals. The best move right now is patience.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines and keep your cash ready. Wait for the market fear to stabilize or for a clear technical reversal pattern before jumping in. There's no rush — better setups will come.

ETH has a 0.34x risk/reward ratio per its own chart analysis, which per validated rule #9 should cap confidence at 35% or downgrade to HOLD. LDO's 0.42x R/R is similarly unfavorable. The Fear & Greed at 26 (near the validated rule threshold of 25 for bearish continuation) with a worsening trend adds macro headwind. No funding rate data is available for any candidate, removing a key signal. With fewer than 3 core signals returning valid data for most candidates, the responsible action per validated rule #3 is to exercise extreme caution.
